segments.iti11:2.1: “Mohaṃ, bhikkhave, anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya.
segments.iti11:2.2: Mohañca kho, bhikkhave, abhijānaṃ parijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ virājayaṃ pajahaṃ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāyā”ti.
segments.iti11:3.5: Pahāya na punāyanti, imaṃ lokaṃ kudācanan”ti.
segments.iti11:4.1: Ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti.
